site_name: ST DUNSTANS COLLEGE, STANSTEAD ROAD, LONDON, SE6 4TY
description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/25/138649) dated 16 May 2025, for the variation of Condition (2) Approved Plans in order to allow minor amendments to the approved scheme, at St. Dunstan's College, Stanstead Road, SE6 4TY. Proposed Amendments:1.	Adjustment of the width of each of the 3 terrace areas; 2.	The provision of 1 additional table tennis table; 3.	A reduction in the number of benches in the seating area; 4.	A reduction in the number of trees being planted (from 7 to 6); 5.	Rearrangement of the 6 approved Four Square Pitches; and 6.	The removal of the southern canopy.
